== Version ==
These guides cover '''1.0.1.5''', released on 27 November 2026. See [[Version 1.0.1.5]] for the latest patch and [[Versions]] for earlier versions. The [[Version 1.0.0.0|1.0 release]] ended Early Access. Other versions may differ.

Default stats and acquisition tables describe public 1.0.1.5; [[Achievements]] explains the unlock conditions and limits. The latest patch adds Polish and an Eating Sounds setting, fixes newly finished raft interactions, and changes spider-cave revisit replenishment. Existing stats and recipes are unchanged.
